name: Subscription Slayer
tagline: Spot every recurring charge hiding in your statements and stop paying for it
description: Drop in a card or bank statement and it lists every subscription that has crept upward, doubled up, or outlived its trial. Each finding comes with a ready-to-send note requesting a cancellation or a better rate. Nothing goes out on its own, you press send.
author: BTC_Yogi
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
